name: rosetta-greatest-subsequential-sum
code:
use default

use RUN = (start: int, finish: int, total: int)

greatest_run(values: int[]) -> RUN is
    let best mut = (start = 0, finish = 0, total = 0)
    let running mut = best

    for index in 0..values.count do
        let extended = running.total + values[index]

        running =
            if extended > 0 then
                (start = running.start, finish = index + 1,
                 total = extended)
            else
                (start = index + 1, finish = index + 1, total = 0)
            fi

        if running.total > best.total then
            best = running
        fi
    od

    best
si

list(values: int[]) -> string =>
    values |> map(value => "{value}") |> join(", ")

let values = [-1, -2, 3, 5, 6, -2, -1, 4, -4, 2, -1]
let best = greatest_run(values)

let greatest = (best.start..best.finish)
    |> map(index => "{values[index]}")
    |> join(", ")

write_line("sequence: [{list(values)}]")
write_line("greatest subsequence: [{greatest}], sum {best.total}")
